name: Serial Killer Simulator
summary:
Step behind the mask in Serial Killer Simulator, a VR slasher horror game where you become the threat lurking beyond the campfire.
Stalk isolated camps, watch your targets, and choose your moment to strike. Move through dark forests, search cabins, and turn familiar surroundings into places of terror. Get close, grab your victims, swing your weapon, and use the environment in brutal, physics-based encounters.
The campers won’t simply wait for you. They search for supplies,  hide, warn each other, fight back
